datasets.name: nq-rag
notes: Gold passages are MAPPED, not annotated: gold(q) = { d : BEIR nq qrels mark d relevant to q, and normalize(d.text) contains normalize(a) as a whole-token span for some nq-open answer a }; normalize = SQuAD answer normalisation (lowercase, strip punctuation and English articles, collapse whitespace); passage title not searched; questions joined BEIR<->nq-open on normalize_question(text) and kept only if gold(q) is non-empty
Mapping coverage: beir_test_queries_with_qrels=3452, joined_to_nq_open=2255, with_mapped_gold=2083, coverage_of_joined=0.9237, judged_passages_of_joined=2816, gold_passages_of_mapped=2425
Corpus capped by a seeded reservoir sample with every judged passage of a kept question forced in.
datasets.source: BeIR/nq corpus + BeIR/nq-qrels test qrels + google-research-datasets/nq_open validation answers
